one_liner: Trea Turner put 866 balls in play at 83.5 mph average exit velocity -- contact volume rather than contact force.
three_things: 83.5 mph average exit velocity with a 102.3 mph 90th percentile.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). The contact numbers -- exit velocity and estimated wOBA on contact -- cover the batted balls only, not every pitch seen, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. This pull has no sprint-speed or baserunning column, so the part of his profile that turns weak contact into outcomes is invisible here.
